findings: The commissioned playback has not occurred and must not be reported as done.

Canonical source was repaired so background phone_shell dispatches before overlay_control_gate, but the running phone relay still executes the older gate order; repository implementation is not runtime deployment.
Fresh primary-phone receipts show the old running relay terminal-fails phone_shell with 'Home Center control is disabled from the on-screen operator overlay'.
The operator overlay is installed, readable, and now deliberately surfaced; fresh state is controlEnabled=false, overlayHidden=false, panelCollapsed=true.

Remote enable/disable is intentionally absent: the provider is read-only and the architecture reserves re-enable to the on-screen user-owned control. Overlay maintenance can surface the UI but cannot restore control authority.
Read-only phone_diagnostics cannot write, execute subprocesses, use network, install, build, or mutate UI, so it cannot deploy the fixed relay.

The deployed Home Center operation registry exposes no callable SSH operation to primary-phone; tools/ssh_axis.py requires an executing runtime and an independently configured phone endpoint, neither of which is callable from this chat surface. Venice Nerve is not registered/online. No authorized non-operator recovery surface found can mutate the live relay while control is off.

This is a circular bootstrap boundary caused by a deployed defect, not the intended Phone Shell architecture. The smallest authority-restoring action is one local tap of Enable control on the now-visible Home Center overlay. After that, execution must resume immediately rather than treating the tap as completion.
